correctness.rationale: The proof reduces Cohen's root condition to intersections of the pair-product span with the two local matrix algebras. The dimension upper bound is immediate from the repeated diagonal products. A standalone exact finite-field certificate proves one Gaussian-rational Cayley witness has pair-span ranks 3,7,13,16 and local-sum ranks 6/6, 10/10, 16/16, 16/16 for the two parties. Nonvanishing real-analytic minors then give the Haar-almost-sure ranks. The positive-POVM construction from a full span uses a Hermitian coefficient preimage and a sufficiently small perturbation of a positive scalar identity. No finite sample is used to infer the infinite generic statement.

value.rationale: The theorem converts a published numerical transition into an exact structural statement at the first nontrivial global dimension. It proves an infinite Haar-generic non-LOCC family for two through four random unitaries and identifies the exact point at which that particular obstruction necessarily disappears. The m=4 critical case and m=5 transition are mathematically motivated directly by the source and are not arbitrary parameter slices.
